8.46600,49.48750.name: knoell
8.46600,49.48750.state: Mannheim, Germany — with offices in the US, UK and Asia
8.46600,49.48750.desc: A regulatory consultancy that writes the submissions. Its published service list includes dossier preparation for the European food safety authority in the required electronic format, US federal and state pesticide registration, study management and monitoring, and — named explicitly — agronomic equivalence evaluation, meaning the comparison of an engineered plant against conventional varieties. It also selects which laboratory performs a study, with the stated aim of producing data usable for submissions in more than one country. That is the mechanism this facet exists to show: the same firm can design the study, choose the laboratory, interpret the result and write the argument the regulator reads, and none of those steps is hidden — they are the product being sold.

4.35170,50.85030.name: European Medicines Agency
4.35170,50.85030.desc: A viral vector vaccine falls within the European Union's own definition of a genetically modified organism, and until 2020 that meant an environmental risk assessment and consent under the deliberate release and contained use directives before a clinical trial could proceed. On 15 July 2020 Parliament and Council suspended that requirement for COVID-19 products by regulation: packaging, storage, transport, disposal, distribution, supply and administration in an authorised trial no longer needed the prior assessment or consent, though manufacturing sites and the genetic modification of wild-type viruses stayed inside the contained use rules, and a marketed product still required the assessment. Sponsors were instead obliged to take appropriate measures against foreseeable negative environmental effects of intended or unintended release. Whatever one concludes about the emergency, this is the clearest instance anywhere of a jurisdiction setting aside its own biosafety procedure under time pressure — and of that procedure being described, by its own legislature, as too slow to use when it mattered.
